description: This file contains data transfer object (DTO) class definitions used for network operations in the app, including login, token refresh, and protected resource responses.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: DTO representing the login request payload with username and password.

classes.name: RefreshRequest
classes.description: DTO representing the token refresh request with a refresh token.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: DTO representing the response containing access and refresh tokens, along with the expiration time of the access token.

classes.name: ProtectedResponse
classes.description: DTO representing a protected resource response containing a message.
